title: Spectacular Sunset Sail on San Diego Bay
blurb:
A rare sunset sailing adventure aboard our 35-foot sailboat, Luna: small group limited to six people, local captain sharing stories, hands-on sailing, and unforgettable vistas of San Diego. Watch for playful sea lions, dolphins, and pelicans. Participate or sit back and enjoy breathtaking sunset views of the city's skyline and waterfront attractions as we sail among tall ships, mega-yachts, and military vessels. 

We invite you to celebrate a special occasion with your partner, family or group and capture the moments in breathtaking photos. 

No sailing experience is needed for this family-friendly outing, but participation is welcome. We love sharing our knowledge and experience.

Choose a public or private tour option when you book.

Snacks and bottled water included. Feel free to bring your own easy to handle alcoholic/non-alcoholic beverages and snacks.

Free cancellation, 100% refund up to 24 hours before your reservation.
